title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1967-01-14
lineage: CDR > EAC(secure) > Cool Edit(remove isolated pops) > mkwact(seekable)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of an early 1967 three‑song set with solid jams on Morning Dew and Viola Lee Blues, though the lo‑fi tape limits clarity.
ai_review.review: The recording preserves a raw, three‑track early Dead show that showcases extended jam vibes—especially on Morning Dew and Viola Lee Blues—with a notable flute texture on Good Morning Little Schoolgirl. While fans appreciate its historical significance, the primitive soundboard quality leaves some vocals sounding jarring and overall fidelity modest.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split between high enthusiasm for the historic setlist and low scores pointing out poor audio or missing information; weighting show merit (70%) against limited recording comments (30%) yields a modest overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit technical commentary, but early‑1967 soundboard recordings are typically modest in fidelity; reviewers note jarring vocals and lack of clarity, suggesting a somewhat muddy tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A brief three‑song set that opens with Morning Dew, followed by Viola Lee Blues and closes with Good Morning Little Schoolgirl; the jam‑heavy vibe feels like a drum‑circle session, though it lacks the expected opener (e.g., Dancing in the Streets) noted elsewhere.
